notes: Three flocks of brant observed at Ohio Point proceeding north along western shoreline of Cold Bay. 'These birds were coming in from the open sea, not skirting the coast.' Significant for understanding migration routes.
Rapid initial influx: 'by September 3rd there were an estimated 150,000 in the Lagoon.'
Last identifiable new arrival: 'The last flock that we were able to identify as newly arrived, did so on November 3rd, just five days before migration.'
Migration inferred ~November 8 based on 'just five days before migration' from Nov 3 context.
Annual census total: Adult=17,537, Juv=3,741, Total=21,278, %Juv=17.6. Math verified: 17537+3741=21278, 3741/21278=17.58%.
Dr. T.W. Barry reported brant lingering along coast of Northwest Territories as late as October 1st this year.
